# Vimal Harihar S K

> Vimal Harihar S K (GitHub: Goldmauler) is a Software Engineer and B.Tech Computer Science student (2023–2027) at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore, India, working on AI/ML, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, edge AI/TinyML and distributed systems.

- Software & AI Intern at Innoboon (Apr–Jun 2026): RAG + Deep Agents for JIRA ↔ GCP incident correlation.
- Web Development Lead, Tensor AI Club, Amrita (2024–2026): led 20 developers; platform with 1,200+ users.
- Winner, Infineon PSoC 6 Hackathon (2025). Finalist: Caterpillar Tech Challenge 2026, AWS AI for Bharat 2026, Smart India Hackathon 2025. 35+ hackathons.
- 4 research publications, including an IEEE paper on AI's influence on gender representation and societal norms.
